question: As of February 2020, which of the following players has won the highest number of tennis grand slam men singles category tournaments?
solution:
The correct answer is __Roger Federer.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Roger Federer has won the **maximum number of Grand Slam men's singles tournaments in Tennis.**
 
• He has won a total of** 20 grand slam tournaments (till 2020), **the most in the history of male players.
 
• He is a professional tennis player from Switzerland.
 
• He is at the number **1 position in the ATP ranking for consecutive 310 weeks, which is also a world record.**
 
• Federer has won a record** eight Wimbledon men's singles titles, six Australian Open titles, five US Open titles, and one French Open title.**
 
• He is one of eight men to have achieved a Career Grand Slam (won all four Grand Slam titles).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rafael Nadal won 19 Grand Slam titles (till 2020).
 
• Novak Djokovic won 17 Grand Slam titles. (till 2020).
 
• **Leander Paes** is a professional Lawn Tennis Player.
 
 
• He won Arjuna Awards in 1990, Padma Shri in 2001 and Padma Bhushan in 2014.
 
• He has won **eight career Grand Slam doubles titles and ten career Grand Slam mixed doubles championships.**
